bootstrap.description: Trusted local bootstrap/settings UI. Core defaults plus the app's own commands (gated by the app ACL generated in build.rs).

harness.description: The remote Harness WebView (http://127.0.0.1:<port>). Deliberately empty: this webview has NO IPC surface — no core modules, no app commands, no shell/fs/process. It can only talk HTTP to the local Harness server.
